description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage (in gigabytes) for different methods, including Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and the proposed method labeled "Ours." The vertical axis represents GPU memory in GB, ranging from 0 to 70 with increments of 20, while the horizontal axis lists the methods. The tallest bar corresponds to Full FT, indicating a GPU memory usage of approximately 70 GB. MTL-FT follows with around 40 GB, TAG and LoRA each use about 22 GB, and QLoRA uses approximately 14 GB. The method labeled "Ours" is represented by a green bar, showing a GPU memory usage of about 22 GB, which is comparable to TAG and LoRA. The chart highlights that the proposed method achieves a significant reduction in GPU memory usage compared to Full FT and MTL-FT, while maintaining a similar memory footprint to other efficient fine-tuning methods.
